name: Yew Lee Pacific Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股份拆细/附加上市（Additional Listing Announcement /Subdivision of Shares）及季度业绩发布，未披露各业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订等具体业务变化。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收480.5万令吉，同比增5.8%；净利润52.7万令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements were mainly additional listing announcements/subdivision of shares and quarterly results. No specific business changes such as expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins were disclosed for any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 4.805 million, up 5.8% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 0.527 million.
